title: 预测与重建：自监督语言表示学习的联合目标
summary: 提出一种结合JEPA风格潜在空间预测损失与标准MLM目标的混合预训练目标，通过可学习标量参数平衡两者。在GLUE基准上分析表明，混合编码器产生更均匀的嵌入，具有更丰富的谱几何结构，编码更少的表层词汇信息，实现更好的语义-词汇平衡。
summary_en: Proposes a hybrid pre-training objective combining JEPA-style latent-space prediction loss with standard MLM, balanced by a learnable scalar. Analysis on GLUE benchmarks shows the hybrid encoder produces more uniform embeddings, richer spectral geometry, less surface-level lexical information, and better semantic-lexical balance.
